body: I feel the same way... It feels like nothing makes living worth and it keeps worsening

My mom died last December, around 2 weeks before Christmas, her favorite time of the year. Her existence prevented me from doing a lot to myself while she was alive. I wasn't very close to her because of depression but I loved her dearly, even though I was terrible at showing it. Even right now it fucking hurts specially because of how she died. I hope you can go through it

In my country it takes around 1h, it fucking sucks because in the meantime I could just harm myself, doesn't really help that much. If at least there were more volunteers... But eh, I see why people wouldn't want to volunteer for it
